testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23088 sales rep assigned to an all-stores user applies to the default store only

scenario.summary: For a user with All Stores access and store A as the selected store, the admin assigns a store A sales rep; the assignment applies to store A only, not to another store.
steps: Accounts & Users > Users; open the All Stores user (@user.userId) with Manage.
Ensure store A (@storeA.name) is selected in the Store Name dropdown.
Click the search icon next to Sales Rep; select the store A sales rep (@rep.fullName).
Re-open the user: with store A the Sales Rep shows the rep; with store B (@storeB.name) it does not.
stateChanges: The user's store A sales rep is set (both deleted at teardown).
assertions: The selected sales rep is associated with the user for store A
The assignment does not apply to store B
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 9 (group B remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 9.3.
FSD 'Store Assignment Rules for Sales Rep'.

An All Stores user can only be created when AllowGlobalUserCreation is on: GLOBAL_USER_CREATION_ENABLED is checked first and the test is skipped when it is not True (as 23089; user decision 2026-11-25, analysis 9.3). On atstage the setting is off, so the test skips.
Manage User requires first and last name and the created user has none: the test fills names it makes up (created-by-test) before Save and Close, as 23085.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A). Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId (any other active webstore).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
